ar.name: ComfyUI

items.name: ComfyUI
items.description: A node-based, modular workflow engine for Stable Diffusion and Flux that gives you pixel-perfect control over every step of generation.

items.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI (A1111)
items.description: The most popular one-click Gradio interface for Stable Diffusion with an enormous extension ecosystem.

ar.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge
ar.description: نسخة مشتقة من A1111 تركّز على الأداء مع تحسين الذاكرة وتسريع أخذ العينات ودعم أصلي لـ Flux.

items.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge
items.description: A performance-focused fork of A1111 with memory optimization, faster sampling and native Flux support.

ar.name: InvokeAI

items.name: InvokeAI
items.description: A professional image studio with unified canvas, control layers and batch tools built on a modern React frontend.

items.description: A free, offline Midjourney-inspired generator with automatic optimization and a minimal, user-friendly interface.

items.name: Hugging Face Diffusers
items.description: The Python library for running, training and sharing diffusion models with first-party support for all major architectures.
